Date ____ 19____

Official Report of Search

At 2.15 p.m. on March 28, 1932 We, Armand Marmorat,
Chief of the Search Brigade of the Political Section of the
Police of the French Concession of Shanghai, accompanied
by interpreter Andre Loh and detective No. 308, in the
presence of Tsong Tse Ching (    ), cigarette merchant,
occupier of house No. 19 Rue des Peres, have effected a search
in an unoccupied room on the ground floor of the said house,
where we had been informed explosives were to be found.
Inside the room, which we found locked and had opened
by Tsong Tse Tching, we took possession of the following
articles :-

(1) Thirteen galvanised sheet-iron cylinders painted black
on the outside - fifty centimetres long by thirteen
centimetres in diameter, empty.

(2) Two cylinders of the same type filled with orange powder
resembling that generally used in charging incendiary
explosives.

(3) Five cylinders, similar to the preceding ones, filled
with coal dust.

(4) A foreign made hand bag which was locked and contained :-

A) Three letters emanating from one Teng Hsi Ling (    )
Room 525, Oriental Hotel, addressed to one Ou Ki Toha
(    ), Burlington Hotel, telling the latter to
expedite the loading of the mines etc...

B) Two more letters from one King Yien Wen (    ),
Burlington Hotel, addressed to Ou Ki Tohang, calling
on him to bring to a successful conclusion the mission
entrusted him.

C) Four account books with entries.

D) Two visiting cards in the name of Teng Hsi Ling, native of
Kiangsu, Advisor at the Headquarters of the 4th Squadron
of the Cantonese Navy and King Yien Wen, General Counsellor
of the above Headquarters.

E) Two maps of Shanghai and neighbouring district and one map
of Chekiang Province.

(5) A roll of conducting wire.

(6) Ten anti-Japanese pamphlets

(7) Two maps fixed to the wall, showing the Kiangwan area
overrun by the Japanese.

From all of which we have drawn up the present written
minute, in order to be transmitted to the Administrative
Authorities of the French Concession, to be used as they
think fit.

搜查正式报告

1932年3月28日下午2时15分，我们，上海法租界警务处政治部搜查队队长阿曼德·马莫拉（Armand Marmorat），在翻译安德烈·罗（Andre Loh）和308号侦探的陪同下，在神父路（Rue des Peres）19号住户、烟商宗泽清（Tsong Tse Ching，音译）在场的情况下，对该房屋底层一间空置房间进行了搜查，此前我们获报该处藏有爆炸物。
在该房间内，我们发现房门上锁，由宗泽清打开后，我们扣押了以下物品：-

(1) 十三个镀锌铁皮圆筒，外部漆成黑色——长五十厘米，直径十三厘米，为空筒。

(2) 两个同类型圆筒，装满橙色粉末，类似于通常用于装填燃烧性炸药的粉末。

(3) 五个与上述类似的圆筒，装满煤粉。

(4) 一个上锁的外国制造手提包，内含：-

pages.en:
STATEMENT OF EVIDENCE

At 3 p.m. on March 30, 1932, before us Armand Marmorat,
Chief of the Search Brigade of the Political Section of the
Police of the French Concession of Shanghai, assisted by
Interpreter Andre Loh appeared Tsong Tse Tsin (          ),
Cigarette Merchant at No.19 Rue des Peres, where he also
resides, who made the following statement:-

"My name is Tsong Tse Tsin, native of Tsunning, Kiangsu
Province, age 48 years, manager of the "Sing Gni Tah" shop
(          ) 19 Rue des Peres, where I reside.
On March 23 this year I let the room at the rear of my
shop for an indefinite period, at 28 dollars Mex. per mensem,
to one Huang (          ). Lighting was included in the rental.
I saw Huang, accompanied by a workman whom I do not know
bring three iron casks at about 5 p.m. on March 24. I did not
see the sheet-iron cylinders being transported.
It was the workman who slept in the room in question.
Huang came three times in all :
On March 23, at about 2 p.m. to rent the room.
On March 24, at about 10 a.m., in order to advance me ten
dollars on the rent and again, the same day, at about 5 p.m.,
accompanied by the workman, bringing the casks.
I did not make enquiries regarding the occupation of
Huang and the workman and I never entered the room prior to
the coming of the Police.
The last time I saw the workman was at 5 p.m. on Marc 25,
as he was leaving the room."

From which we have drawn up the present written minute,
to be forwarded to the Administrative Authorities of the
French Concession, to be used as they think fit.
pages.zh:
证词陈述

1932年3月30日下午3时，在我们上海法租界警务处政治部搜查队队长阿曼德·马莫拉面前，在翻译安德烈·罗的协助下，神父路19号烟商宗泽津（Tsong Tse Tsin，音译）出庭作证，他亦居住于此，并作如下陈述：-

“我叫宗泽津，江苏省镇江人，现年48岁，是‘兴尼达’商店（Sing Gni Tah，音译）经理，店址及住址均为神父路19号。
今年3月23日，我将店铺后方的房间以每月28墨西哥银元的租金无限期出租给一名姓黄的人（Huang，音译）。租金包含照明费用。
3月24日下午5点左右，我看见黄某带着一名我不认识的工人搬来三个铁桶。我没有看见铁皮圆筒被搬运。
睡在那间房间里的是那名工人。
黄某总共来了三次：
3月23日下午2点左右，来租用房间。
3月24日上午10点左右，为了预付我十美元租金，以及当天再次于下午5点左右，带着那名工人，搬来铁桶。
我没有询问黄某和工人的职业，在警察到来之前，我也从未进入过该房间。
我最后一次见到那名工人是在3月25日下午5点，当时他正离开房间。”

据此，我们制作了本书面笔录，以便转交法租界行政当局，供其酌情使用。

pages.en:
REPORT No 34/R
-------

Subject : Explosives found at No 19 Rue des Peres

At 10 a.m. on March 28 a detective from the Bureau of Public Safety informed me that a bomb manufactory had been installed in a small street, between Avenue Edward VII and Rue du Consulat, in the French Concession.
I got this detective to make a sketch of the place and began personal enquiries, accompanied by interpreter Andre Loh.
Not having succeeded in finding the locality, I requested the detective to point it out to me. When questioned the latter stated that he had been ordered by the Chief of the Public Safety Bureau to warn the French Police of the presence of the factory without, however, concerning himself officially in the matter.
At 2.15 p.m., accompanied by Interpreter Loh, Detective No 308 and the detective from the Public Safety Bureau, I continued my investigations and ended by discovering in an unoccupied room, at the rear of a cigarette seller's shop in House No 19 Rue des Peres, some sheet-metal cylinders, painted black. Affixed to the walls of the room in question were anti-Japanese notices of propaganda and plans of Shanghai and districts around Shanghai.
I immediately advised the Officer i/c Political Branch, who arrived upon the scene with Sub-inspector Saint-Oyant.
In the room was found a portmanteau containing maps of Shanghai, printed in English and Chinese, letters and books, which were confiscated (Vide list and translation attached).
Sergeant Le Scanf was also apprised of the foregoing and attended, taking away 7 full cylinders - 5 containing coal dust and 2 orange powder - 13 cylinders empty. Three empty steel casks, of the type used in transporting black powder, were left behind in the room.
In the drawers of the desk was seized a coil of electric wire and pamphlets of the same kind as those stuck upon the wall.
From enquiries made on the spot it appears that two persons rented this room on March 23 and that they brought the casks on March 24. The proprietor was apparently not otherwise disturbed by the tenants of the room. Neighbours, when questioned, stated that they had not noticed anything suspicious about the movements of the two individuals.
The premises are being watched. Enquiries proceeding.

Chief of the Search Brigade.

(signed) A. Marmorat.
pages.zh:
报告编号 34/R
-------

主题：神父路19号发现爆炸物

3月28日上午10时，公共安全局的一名侦探通知我，在法租界爱德华七世大道（Avenue Edward VII）和领事馆路（Rue du Consulat）之间的一条小街上，设立了一个炸弹制造厂。
我让这名侦探画了一张地点草图，并在翻译安德烈·罗的陪同下开始个人调查。
由于未能找到该地点，我请求该侦探指认。经询问，后者称他是受公共安全局局长命令，警告法国警方该工厂的存在，但并未正式介入此事。
下午2时15分，在翻译罗、308号侦探以及来自公共安全局的侦探的陪同下，我继续调查，最终在神父路19号一家烟店后部的一间空置房间内，发现了一些漆成黑色的金属圆筒。该房间的墙壁上贴有反日宣传标语以及上海及其周边地区的地图。
我立即通知政治部主任，他与副督察圣奥扬（Saint-Oyant）一同抵达现场。
在房间内发现一个手提箱，内含中英文印刷的上海地图、信件和书籍，均被没收（参见附上的清单和译文）。
勒斯坎夫（Le Scanf）警长也获悉上述情况并到场，带走了7个装满的圆筒——5个装有煤粉，2个装有橙色粉末——以及13个空圆筒。房间内留下了三个空钢桶，属于运输黑火药常用的类型。
在书桌抽屉里查获了一卷电线和与墙上张贴相同类型的小册子。
根据现场调查，似乎有两人于3月23日租用了此房间，并于3月24日搬来铁桶。房东显然未受到房间租户的其他干扰。邻居在接受询问时表示，他们未注意到这两人的行动有任何可疑之处。
该场所正在监视中。调查正在进行。

搜查队队长。

（签名）A. 马莫拉。

pages.en:
(Continuation of Report No 34/R)

At 5 p.m. on March 28 Chief Inspector Emelianoff sent
for me at the Police Club, where representatives from the
Japanese Consulate-General, in the company of Inspector
Huen, informed me that a factory for making mines destined
to blow up Japanese warships had been installed in the
French Concession. A sketch, similar to that made by the
detective from the Public Safety Bureau, was shown me. Aware
that this was the same case as the one I had just completed,
I replied to the Japanese detectives that I had received
practically the same information that very morning and that I
was making enquiries with a view to discovering the
whereabouts of the factory in question. I promised, at the
same time, to give a reply that evening.

I informed the Officer on duty who ordered Chief
Inspector Emelianoff to reply to the Japanese Consulate in
the evening

Officer i/c Search Brigade
pages.zh:
（第34/R号报告续）

3月28日下午5时，总督察埃梅利亚诺夫（Emelianoff）在警察俱乐部召见我，日本总领事馆的代表在许恩（Huen，音译）督察的陪同下告知我，法租界内已设立一个制造旨在炸毁日本军舰的水雷的工厂。向我展示了一幅草图，与公共安全局侦探所绘制的相似。意识到这与我刚处理完的案件相同，我回复日本侦探说，我当天早上也收到了几乎相同的信息，并且我正在进行调查，以查明该工厂的下落。同时，我承诺当晚给予答复。

我通知了值班警官，他命令总督察埃梅利亚诺夫在晚上回复日本领事馆

搜查队主管警官

REPORT OF INVESTIGATION No 35/R
--------------------------------

Subject : Bombs found at 19 Rue des Peres - continuation
of Report No 34/R.

Room No 525, Oriental Hotel, Sincere Building, was
occupied from March 4, 1932 to March 28 1932 by the three
following persons :-

FENG LO HSI (        ), 41 years, native of Canton, employed in
the Cantonese Navy, came from Hongkong - 4/3 to 19/3 (15 days
in all).

CHANG CHIH CHING (        )?, 30 years, native of Wuchieh,
merchant at Shanghai - 19/3 (1 day only)

WANG TSENG YA (        ), 34 years, native of Fenghwa (Chekiang),
employed at the Yue Tan Co., 6 Szechuen Road > 25/3 to 28/3
(3 days in all).

These three names do not correspond with any of the
names mentioned in the letters seized at No 19 Rue des Peres.
The confiscated letters, written on the Hotel paper, are dated
March 9 to March 13. As FENG LO HSI (        ) left Room No 525
on March 15, it is probable that TENG HSI LING (        ), the
signatory of the letters, occupied this room under another
name.

The hotel staff state that they noticed nothing
suspicious about the occupants of the room, especially with
regard to FENG LO HSI.

The watch kept at No 19 Rue des Peres has not yet given
any result.

调查报告第 35/R 号
---

主题：神父路 19 号发现的炸弹——第 34/R 号报告之续篇。

1932 年 3 月 4 日至 1932 年 3 月 28 日，先施公司大楼汇中饭店 525 室由以下三人居住：

FENG LO HSI（音译），41 岁，广东人，任职于广东海军，来自香港——3 月 4 日至 19 日（共 15 天）。

CHANG CHIH CHING（音译）？，30 岁，吴县人，上海商人——3 月 19 日（仅 1 天）

WANG TSENG YA（音译），34 岁，浙江奉化人，任职于四川路 6 号 Yue Tan 公司（音译）——3 月 25 日至 28 日（共 3 天）。

这三个名字与在神父路 19 号查获的信件中提到的任何名字均不符。
没收的信件写在饭店信纸上，日期为 3 月 9 日至 3 月 13 日。由于 FENG LO HSI（音译）于 3 月 15 日离开 525 室，很可能信件的签署人 TENG HSI LING（音译）使用了另一个名字入住了该房间。

饭店职员表示，他们未注意到住客有任何可疑之处，尤其是关于 FENG LO HSI。

对神父路 19 号的监视尚未取得任何结果。

---

pages.en:
REPORT No 37/R
----------
Subject : Explosives found at No 19 Rue des Peres -
Continuation of Report No 34/R and 35/R.

One KING YIEN WEN (      ), native of Canton, age
about 30 years, occupied room No 208 at the Burlington Hotel
from March 4 to 15 inclusive. The characters entered in the
hotel register are exactly the same as those figuring in
the letters and on the visiting card confiscated at No 19
Rue des Peres.

From enquiries made, KING YIEN WEN received many
visitors; but no information is available that any known
politician was among them.

It appears that KING YIEN WEN stayed at the Burlington
for as long a period as TENG HSI LING (      ) ( at the
Oriental Hotel - from March 4 to March 15.

Enquiries proceeding.
pages.zh:
报告第 37/R 号
---
主题：神父路 19 号发现的炸药——第 34/R 号和 35/R 号报告之续篇。

一名叫 KING YIEN WEN（音译）的人，广东人，年龄约 30 岁，于 3 月 4 日至 15 日（含首尾两日）入住礼查饭店 208 室。饭店登记簿上登记的汉字与在神父路 19 号查获的信件和名片上的汉字完全相同。

经查询，KING YIEN WEN 接待了许多访客；但无资料显示其中有已知的政客。

看来 KING YIEN WEN 在礼查饭店停留的时间与 TENG HSI LING（音译）在汇中饭店停留的时间一样长——均为 3 月 4 日至 3 月 15 日。

调查正在进行中。

pages.en:
REPORT No 39/R

Subject : Explosives found at 19 Rue des Peres - Continuation
of Reports 34/R, 35/R and 37/R.

It has not been possible to find Gno Ming Li, Avenue
Road. According to our information, this Passage is unknown.
No person of the name of CHANG CHIH JU (      ), has
registered at the Man Yien Li Tzo, Hankow Road where,
moreover, there is no Room No 12. The same applies to KOH TAH
YI (      ). The rooms in this hotel begin with No 101.
The dates when the rooms were occupied do not give
any clue which might, if such were the case, aid us in our
investigations.
Presumably the three last addresses in Book No 1 are
incorrect.
pages.zh:
报告第 39/R 号

主题：神父路 19 号发现的炸药——第 34/R、35/R 和 37/R 号报告之续篇。

未能找到爱文义路的 Gno Ming Li（音译）。据我们所知，该弄堂不为人知。
名为 CHANG CHIH JU（音译）的人未在汉口路的 Man Yien Li Tzo 饭店（音译）登记，况且该饭店没有 12 号房间。KOH TAH YI（音译）的情况也是如此。该饭店的房间号从 101 号开始。
房间的入住日期并未提供任何线索，即便有，也无助于我们的调查。
推测第一本账簿中的最后三个地址是不正确的。
